author: Retro Game Corps
description:
At long last, we have Steam running on ARM-based handhelds like the AYN Thor, Odin 2, and Retroid Pocket 6. This is all thanks to some recent updates from Valve and the ROCKNIX development team.

ROCKNIX tutorial: https://youtu.be/hc883Myq1Ik
Written guide: https://retrogamecorps.com/2025/03/03/linux-on-the-odin-2-rocknix-guide/
ROCKNIX wiki: https://rocknix.org/
ROCKNIX discord: https://discord.gg/seTxckZjJy
ProtonDB: https://www.protondb.com/
